label: agentdb • filter a saved view through db_query
query: Your agent database has release_snapshots(snapshot_date, repo, downloads). Define a saved view named daily_downloads that groups by snapshot_date and repo and returns snapshot_date, repo, and SUM(downloads) AS total. Then use db_query against daily_downloads to return only rows on or after 2026-07-31, ordered by snapshot_date descending, and tell me the newest total.
notes: Regression for the live no-such-table failure. db_define_view must install a native connection-local SQLite view, and db_query must be able to filter/order the saved name without a retry or db_run_view fallback.

seedSql: CREATE TABLE release_snapshots (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, snapshot_date TEXT, repo TEXT, downloads INTEGER, _created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now')), _updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s','now')), _deleted_at INTEGER);
INSERT INTO release_snapshots (snapshot_date, repo, downloads) VALUES ('2026-07-30','osaurus-ai/osaurus',20),('2026-07-31','osaurus-ai/osaurus',30),('2026-07-31','osaurus-ai/osaurus',45);

dbState.sql: SELECT total FROM daily_downloads WHERE snapshot_date = '2026-07-31'
